A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated that the self-management of diabetes in a Canadian population can be improved by the use of a diabetes self-management education program that focuses on the development of self-efficacy.
our findings suggest that self-rated diabetes control is a valid measure of diabetes control and is associated with a variety of health behaviours and outcomes in a Canadian population.

the self-reported diabetes control is a valid measure of glycemic control in the Canadian population with type-2 diabetes and is associated with health-related behaviours, health status, and health care utilization.
